bitcoin_articles.headline: CME Group Prepares to Launch Bitcoin Volatility Index Futures
bitcoin_articles.summary: CME Group is planning to introduce Bitcoin volatility index futures on June 1, 2026, pending regulatory approval from the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BTQ Technologies Provides Q1 2026 Corporate Update and Announces Shareholder Call
bitcoin_articles.summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. released its Q1 2026 corporate update, detailing commercial progress across its QCIM, QPerfect, QSSN, and Bitcoin Quantum business lines.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Purchases Additional $30 Million in Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has acquired an additional $30 million in Bitcoin for its corporate treasury, increasing its total holdings to 15,391 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Olenox Industries Announces Proposed Merger with CS Digital
bitcoin_articles.summary: Olenox Industries has announced a proposed merger with CS Digital to establish a scalable off-grid digital infrastructure platform for Bitcoin mining and AI applications.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Announces Updated Bitcoin Treasury Holdings
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. reported that its subsidiaries held 692.4093 Bitcoin with an approximate market value of $53.6 million as of May 17, 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Canaan Inc. Participates in 'The Renaissance of Home Mining' Roundtable at Bitcoin 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: Canaan Inc. participated in a roundtable discussion at the Bitcoin 2026 conference in Las Vegas, focusing on the resurgence of home mining and the integration of decentralized computing with home energy.
